lens.message:
Here's the shift: the analytics database question is settled. Quinton's words — "We are adopting Zypherion" — are no longer a proposal in play; they're the organization's standing position, carried by a 15x gain on columnar queries and a Q3 2026 start. It changes how we approach the analytics database architecture (Zypherion is the assumed choice, not an option), migration planning (Q3 2026 is the fixed start), and performance benchmarking (15x on columnar queries is the reference number).

One section, before and after — the Key decisions block:

As written: "Database: Zypherion for analytics · Performance: 15x improvement on columnar queries · Timeline: Migration starts Q3 2026." Three lines recording what was said in the room — a choice, a number, a date.

As it reads now: the same three lines are commitments. "Our current setup" is the legacy system with a named replacement; the 15x figure is the number analytics performance gets judged by; Q3 2026 is the clock every analytics plan runs on. Anything still treating the database choice as open reads as out of date.

Right lens?

What else this moves: honestly, nothing else today — there are no other documents in view on this stream, so the reach right now is this one document. The first places this lands when material appears: anything describing the analytics database as undecided, presenting the current setup as the going concern, or stating query performance without a reference number.

Want me to hold this as the working view and apply it across the documents in one pass once they're in view?
